Statement: Alpine Fresh's about 180 business customers order online instead of emailing Excel sheets: they build or repeat an order on their phone before the 18:00 cut-off, see the delivery status themselves, and every order reaches the ERP in the 18:30 import without retyping.
AcceptanceCriteria: A customer builds or repeats an order on a phone before 18:00
Customers see only their own articles and prices
Customers follow the delivery status without calling the order desk
Every confirmed order is in the 18:30 ERP import without retyping
The order desk can change an order until the cut-off
HighLevelMd:
## Users
- About 180 business customers (restaurants and hotels) ordering on their phones
- The order desk, who handle changes and questions

## Main flows
- Sign in, build an order from the own catalogue and submit it
- Repeat a previous order in one tap
- Order desk changes an order before 18:00
- Customer follows the status from received to delivered

## Volumes
- About 180 customers, ordering mostly on weekdays before the 18:00 cut-off
ArchitectureMd: React web app on SELISE Blocks: IAM sign-in, Data Gateway with row-level access to price lists and orders, Storage, Mail for confirmations, and a nightly CSV export to the ERP.
